QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_28

question.text: In Example 2 of the workbook (NAV pre-incentives Rs. 63.29 crore, hurdle ref Rs. 60.50 crore, incentive rate 15%), incentive fees for Year 2 are:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** (63.29 − 60.50) crore = 2.79 crore excess. 15% × 2.79 = Rs. 41.99 lakh. **The Trap:** Rs. 21.35 lakh is Year 1; Rs. 63.29/60.50 lakh are NAV/hurdle levels. **Cross-Exam Context:** Exactly matches Example 2 Year 2. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** If the fund has 5-year tenure, integrate this calc yearly but only realise at end-of-tenure.
